definition: Use of organization/internal or directly specified concrete compute hardware when no cloud or public/HPC source is identified.
positive_evidence: internal cluster; in-house GPUs; our servers; company GPU cluster; trained on 8 A100 GPUs; used a V100 GPU
negative_boundary: Cloud provider terms and public/HPC facility terms should be labeled as L2 or L3 instead of L1 for the same resource span.
notes: Under this project definition, concrete hardware evidence without an external source is treated as internal/direct compute rather than ambiguous.

definition: Use of commercial cloud computing resources or cloud-hosted accelerator services.
positive_evidence: AWS EC2; Google Cloud TPU; Azure ND-series; SageMaker; Vertex AI
negative_boundary: Do not label cloud when only Google/Meta/OpenAI appears as an author affiliation.
notes: Cloud instance names are strong evidence.

definition: Use of public, national, university, or shared academic HPC resources.
positive_evidence: XSEDE; ACCESS; NERSC; TACC; university HPC; national supercomputing center
negative_boundary: A university affiliation alone is not evidence of using a university compute resource.
notes: Includes public allocation programs and named supercomputers.

definition: Use of an externally hosted model API or commercial API endpoint.
positive_evidence: GPT-4 API; OpenAI API; Claude API; Gemini API; Hugging Face Inference API
negative_boundary: Using an open-source checkpoint locally is not API use.
notes: Hosted inference through an API is label 4 even if the underlying model is named.

definition: Reuse of an existing open-source, released, or pretrained model/checkpoint.
positive_evidence: BERT-base; LLaMA; CLIP; Stable Diffusion; Hugging Face checkpoint
negative_boundary: Mentioning a model only as related work is not reuse.
notes: Can co-occur with compute labels when fine-tuning or inference resources are stated.

definition: Use of compute resources where neither a concrete hardware entity nor a source category is clear from the sentence or accepted context.
positive_evidence: ran on a cluster; used compute resources; experiments were run on servers
negative_boundary: If the same sentence identifies concrete hardware, cloud, internal, or public/HPC source, do not add label 6 for that resource mention.
notes: Concrete hardware-only evidence maps to L1_INTERNAL under the current annotation policy.

definition: No evidence that the sentence uses compute resources, external model APIs, or reused open-source models.
positive_evidence: method description; dataset description; mathematical compute wording
notes: Assign only after all positive labels fail.
